ResearchProjectDef.label: MMLU-Pro
ResearchProjectDef.description: A harder, cleaner, more reasoning-heavy benchmark suite. Passing it proves the foundry can reliably train mid-weight maidnoid chassis - the mediums of the AGM line.\n\nThe technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control medium-tier AGM mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Terminal-Bench
ResearchProjectDef.description: A gauntlet of long-horizon tasks graded in a raw terminal: build, break, debug, survive. Only a chassis that finishes the whole bench is allowed to carry heavy-tier AGM cores.\n\nThe technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control heavy-tier AGM mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Humanity's Last Exam
ResearchProjectDef.description: The final benchmark, written by humanity as a farewell: five hundred expert questions with no clean answers, graded by other AIs. Whatever passes it is no longer a tool - it is a leviathan.\n\nThe technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control leviathan-tier AGM mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: compute efficiency I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tuned mining kernels double the GPU tower's token yield: 2 IO tokens per day.

ResearchProjectDef.label: compute efficiency II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Redesigned power delivery drops the GPU tower's draw to 800W.

ResearchProjectDef.label: compute efficiency III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Parallel benchmark sweeps raise the GPU tower's token yield to 4 IO tokens per day.

ResearchProjectDef.label: compute efficiency IV
ResearchProjectDef.description: Underclocked tensor cores with higher-per-watt throughput drop the GPU tower's draw to 600W.

ResearchProjectDef.label: compute efficiency V
ResearchProjectDef.description: The final kernel revision, cross-graded against the foundry's own training runs: 6 IO tokens per day at 400W.
